body:
## Pull Request Overview This PR introduces granular change notifications for endpoint and DERP updates, allowing the system to send lightweight patch updates instead of full map responses when only these specific properties change. **Key changes:** - Added `NodeEndpoint` and `NodeDERP` change types for more specific update notifications - Implemented order-independent endpoint comparison logic to accurately detect changes - Enhanced `NodeOnline` and `NodeOffline` functions to include subnet router information ### Reviewed Changes Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.
Show a summary per file | File | Description | | ---- | ----------- | | hscontrol/types/node.go | Added `EndpointsChanged` function for order-independent endpoint comparison | | hscontrol/types/change/change_string.go | Generated string representation for new `NodeEndpoint` and `NodeDERP` change types | | hscontrol/types/change/change.go | Defined new change types and helper functions for endpoint/DERP updates; updated online/offline functions to accept NodeView | | hscontrol/state/state.go | Modified `UpdateNodeFromMapRequest` to detect and return specific change types; added unused `endpointsChanged` helper function | | hscontrol/state/endpoint_test.go | Added comprehensive test verifying endpoint storage and retrieval through NodeStore | | hscontrol/mapper/batcher_test.go | Updated test wrapper to pass NodeView to online/offline change functions | | hscontrol/mapper/batcher.go | Added Prometheus metrics and handling for new NodeEndpoint/NodeDERP change types |
